content_sections.heading: RCB Project Research Fellow Important Dates
RCB Project Research Fellow Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Research Fellow post.

content_sections.heading: RCB Project Research Fellow Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Experience of working with 1) Blood sample separation and storing, 2) Handling human blood samples or related biological samples, required for research purposes. 3) Molecular biology assays like ELISA, cell culture, PCR analysis, etc. A certificate of related experience (from concerned principal investigator) should be uploaded. Candidate should have a commitment of at least a year. Experience of 1) Maintain biorepository records, 2) performing experiment using techniques such as flow cytometry microscopy, western blot and mass spectrometry analysis.

rows.qualification_required: M.Sc. in Life Sciences or related natural science disciplines from recognized Universities or equivalent, with at least 60% marks.

content_sections.heading: RCB Project Research Fellow Salary
content_sections.text: The duration is initially for one (01) year, extendable for another year based on performance.

content_sections.heading: RCB Project Research Fellow Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through shortlisting followed by an in-person interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email by 19 October 2026, 5:00 PM to appear for an in-person interview to be held on 26 October 2026, at 10:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCB Project Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal using the link provided in the important links section. Complete the online application form with required details. Upload copies of your M.Sc. or any other equivalent course in Life Sciences certificate. Upload the certificate of work experience from the concerned Principal Investigator. Submit the online application on or before 16 October 2026, 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: M.Sc. or any other equivalent course in Life Sciences certificate Certificate of work experience from concerned Principal Investigator

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment being conducted by Regional Centre for Biotechnology?
faq.answer: Regional Centre for Biotechnology is recruiting for 2 Project Research Fellow posts under an HPV vaccinees study funded by the Serum Institute of India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for RCB Project Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RCB Project Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 16 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Life Sciences or related natural science disciplines from recognized Universities or equivalent, with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for RCB Project Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for RCB Project Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. When will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The in-person interview will be held on 26 October 2026 at 10:00 AM for candidates shortlisted and informed by 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the Project Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The duration is initially for one (01) year, and is extendable for another year based on performance.
